 MyDCD Reports RM25 Million PAT For First Quarter FY27 Ahead Of Bursa Listing
 By Editor 
 November 12, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin 
 MyDCD Berhad announced its first interim financial results for the first quarter ended 30 September 2026 recording revenue of RM178.68 million and profit after tax of RM25.71 million.
 The Group’s revenue was predominantly contributed by its data centre MEPF integration business, which accounted for approximately 96.85% of total revenue during the quarter, demonstrating its established focus on the data centre infrastructure segment. 
 For Q1FY27, MyDCD recorded gross profit of RM37.79 million, translating into a GP margin of 21.15%. The Group’s profit before tax of RM34.06 million was recorded after taking into account total operating expenses of RM3.77 million, which mainly comprised of staff costs of RM2.43 million.
 As this is the Group’s first interim financial report, there are no comparative figures for the immediate preceding quarter.
 As at 30 September 2026, the Group had an outstanding order book of approximately RM1.32 billion, comprising RM1.27 billion from the integration of MEPF systems and subsystems for data centres, which is expected to be recognised progressively up to the financial year ended 30 June 2028 and RM53.08 million from provision of maintenance services and parts, which is expected to be recognised progressively up to financial year ended 30 June 2032. The order book provides the Group with revenue visibility as it continues to execute its secured projects.
 Looking ahead, the Group remains optimistic about its future prospects, supported by continued data centre investments, its existing order book and planned expansion initiatives, which are expected to contribute positively to its future financial performance.
 The company will be listed on Bursa Exchange ACE Market on 17 November 2026.
